messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

    earlier: Team Atlas looks after the flags service as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-02-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]

- The flags service moved from Team Dune to Team Atlas on 2026-04-21. [decision; valid 2026-04-21 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags]
- The flags service moved from Cinder to Team Dune on 2026-01-29. [decision; valid 2026-01-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags]
- The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- Team Dune noticed on 2025-09-18 that the flags service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-09-18 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]
- The notifier is owned by team Boreal as of 2026-04-06, after the Cinder team handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by team Cinder as of 2026-03-17. [valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-17]
- On 2026-05-01, the Cinder team observed that the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01-2]
- Team Dune owns the job scheduler as of 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-scheduler]
    earlier: Ember owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-04; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- Team Dune owns image-resizer as of 2026-01-20, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-01-20 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: Boreal owns image-resizer as of 2025-11-19, after Cinder handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to 2026-01-20; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-image-resizer]
    earlier: Cinder owns image-resizer as of 2025-06-25. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-11-19; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-image-resizer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns image-resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- The flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of the requests were identical. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- The indexer belongs to the Boreal team as of 2025-02-28. [decision; valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer]
    earlier: Cinder owns the indexer as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-02-28; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Billing-api is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-03-25, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-03-25 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-25-billing-api]
    earlier: Billing-api is owned by Boreal as of 2025-12-24, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-24 to 2026-03-25; recorded by handover/2025-12-24-billing-api]
    earlier: Team Atlas owns billing-api as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-24; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- Ledger is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the latency issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
- Team Atlas adopted a no-deploy Friday as of 2025-01-31. [constraint; valid 2025-01-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-31]
- Cinder adopted trunk-based development as of 2025-06-02. [decision; valid 2025-06-02 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-06-02]
- Ledger is not Team Atlas's service, so Team Atlas flagged the disk usage jump instead of fixing it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
